texts.orig: 1 Wingbeat synchrony: a draft for the lab meeting 2 Introduction 3 Lantern moths gather in dusk swarms whose wingbeats lock together. 4 We ask whether the lock depends on colony size. 5 Results 6 Larger colonies beat more nearly in phase than small ones. 7 The order parameter rose from 0.41 to 0.77 across four colonies.
texts.text: 1 Wingbeat synchrony: a draft for the lab meeting 2 Introduction 3 Lantern moths gather in dusk swarms whose wingbeats lock together. 4 We ask whether the lock depends on colony size. 5 Results 6 Larger colonies beat more nearly in phase than small ones. 7 The order parameter rose from 0.41 to 0.77 across four colonies.
